fix_still_open.title: C9 camera.watch over its 0.05 ms per-substep budget
fix_still_open.detail: Improved but not within budget. An exact memo (camera._watch_signature: geometry epoch, robot pose and sensors, the room's agents, ambient light, haze; off while light or occluder hooks are registered) reuses the previous substep's answers, and captures are computed only when someone is private. Lab: 0.083 -> 0.026 ms. Generated houses seeds 0/1/3: 0.14-0.17 -> 0.078-0.090 ms (budget 0.05). The rest is the per-substep geometry-epoch judgement and ambient light; fixing it needs epochs kept by settle and the light hooks, a cross-package change. Test: test_camera test_the_watch_memo_never_changes_the_log.
